item.title: Rotherham and Reading fixtures rescheduled
item.description: Mansfield Town’s Sky Bet League One fixtures against Rotherham United and Reading have been rescheduled. Stags’ match in South Yorkshire was called off due to a frozen pitch on 03 January and has been rearranged for Tuesday 03 March (7.45pm). Mansfield’s game at home to Reading was postponed due to Stags’ progress in the Emirates FA Cup and will now be played on Tuesday 10 March at One Call Stadium (7.45pm kick-off).
